queries.name: Daftar Invoice Belum Lunas
queries.purpose: Menampilkan daftar invoice penjualan yang masih memiliki outstanding per customer.
queries.query: SELECT si.sinotransaksi AS nomor_invoice, si.sitgl AS tanggal_invoice, si.sitgljatuhtempo AS tanggal_jatuh_tempo, c.knama AS nama_customer, si.simatauang AS mata_uang, COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) AS total_invoice, COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) AS total_terbayar, (COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) AS outstanding, CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) < 0 THEN 0 ELSE DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) END AS hari_terlambat, si.sistatuslunas AS status_lunas FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND (COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0 ORDER BY outstanding DESC, si.sitgljatuhtempo ASC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Outstanding per Customer & Risiko
queries.purpose: Merangkum total outstanding per customer dan mengidentifikasi customer dengan risiko keterlambatan tertinggi.
queries.query: SELECT c.knama AS nama_customer, COUNT(si.siid) AS jumlah_invoice_belum_lunas, SUM(COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) AS total_outstanding, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) > 0 THEN (COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_outstanding, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jumlah_invoice_overdue, MAX(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) > 0 THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) ELSE 0 END) AS maksimum_hari_overdue, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) > 0 THEN (COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) * DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) ELSE 0 END) AS skor_risiko_keterlambatan FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND (COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0 GROUP BY c.kid, c.knama ORDER BY overdue_outstanding DESC, maksimum_hari_overdue DESC, total_outstanding DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Distribusi Aging Bucket
queries.purpose: Mengelompokkan outstanding invoice ke bucket umur piutang untuk analisis aging.
queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NULL THEN 'Tanpa Jatuh Tempo' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) < 0 THEN 'Belum Jatuh Tempo' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN '0-30 Hari' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN '31-60 Hari' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN '61-90 Hari' ELSE '>90 Hari' END AS aging_bucket, COUNT(si.siid) AS jumlah_invoice, SUM(COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) AS total_outstanding FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND (COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NULL THEN 'Tanpa Jatuh Tempo' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) < 0 THEN 'Belum Jatuh Tempo' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN '0-30 Hari' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN '31-60 Hari' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN '61-90 Hari' ELSE '>90 Hari' END ORDER BY CASE aging_bucket WHEN 'Tanpa Jatuh Tempo' THEN 1 WHEN 'Belum Jatuh Tempo' THEN 2 WHEN '0-30 Hari' THEN 3 WHEN '31-60 Hari' THEN 4 WHEN '61-90 Hari' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

queries.query: SELECT si.siid AS invoice_id, si.sinotransaksi AS nomor_invoice, si.sitgl AS tanggal_invoice, si.sitgljatuhtempo AS tanggal_jatuh_tempo, c.kkode AS kode_customer, c.knama AS nama_customer, si.simatauang AS mata_uang, si.sitotaltransaksi AS total_invoice, si.sijmlbayar AS total_terbayar, (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) AS outstanding_invoice, si.sistatuslunas AS status_lunas, si.sistatus AS status_dokumen FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON c.kid = si.sicustomer AND c.kaktif = 1 WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND si.sicustomer = ( SELECT x.sicustomer FROM ( SELECT s2.sicustomer, SUM(s2.sitotaltransaksi - s2.sijmlbayar) AS total_outstanding_amount FROM m5_si s2 WHERE s2.siisclose = 0 GROUP BY s2.sicustomer ORDER BY total_outstanding_amount DESC LIMIT 1 ) x ) AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) > 0 ORDER BY outstanding_invoice DESC, si.sitgl DESC LIMIT 100

queries.query: SELECT so.sonotransaksi AS nomor_sales_order, so.sotgl AS tanggal_sales_order, c.knama AS nama_customer, i.bkode AS kode_barang, sod.namabarang AS nama_barang, sod.satuanbarang AS satuan_barang, sod.jmlbarang AS qty_so, COALESCE(sod.jmldo, 0) AS qty_sudah_do, (COALESCE(sod.jmlbarang, 0) - COALESCE(sod.jmldo, 0)) AS qty_belum_do, sod.statusdo AS status_do, sod.statusrealisasi AS status_realisasi FROM m5_so_detail sod INNER JOIN m5_so so ON sod.idso = so.soid LEFT JOIN m1_contact c ON so.socustomer = c.kid AND c.kaktif = 1 LEFT JOIN m1_item i ON sod.idbarang = i.bid AND i.baktif = 1 WHERE so.soisclose = 0 AND sod.isclose = 0 AND COALESCE(sod.jmlbarang, 0) > COALESCE(sod.jmldo, 0) AND (sod.statusdo IS NULL OR sod.statusdo NOT IN ('SELESAI', 'LUNAS')) ORDER BY qty_belum_do DESC, so.sotgl DESC, so.sonotransaksi DESC LIMIT 100

queries.query: SELECT c.kid AS customer_id, c.kkode AS customer_code, c.knama AS customer_name, COALESCE(si_agg.total_sales_invoice, 0) AS total_sales_invoice, COALESCE(si_agg.total_nilai_invoice, 0) AS total_nilai_invoice, COALESCE(sr_agg.total_sales_return, 0) AS total_sales_return, COALESCE(sr_agg.total_nilai_return, 0) AS total_nilai_return, COALESCE(sie_agg.total_tukar_faktur, 0) AS total_tukar_faktur, CASE WHEN COALESCE(si_agg.total_sales_invoice, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(sr_agg.total_sales_return, 0) / si_agg.total_sales_invoice * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS return_rate_by_doc_pct FROM m1_contact c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT si.sicustomer AS customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT si.siid) AS total_sales_invoice, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi) AS total_nilai_invoice FROM m5_si si WHERE si.siisclose = 0 GROUP BY si.sicustomer ) si_agg ON si_agg.customer_id = c.kid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sr.srcustomer AS customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.srid) AS total_sales_return, SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi) AS total_nilai_return FROM m5_sr sr GROUP BY sr.srcustomer ) sr_agg ON sr_agg.customer_id = c.kid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT x.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT x.sieid) AS total_tukar_faktur FROM ( SELECT sd.idsie AS sieid, si.sicustomer AS customer_id FROM m5_sie_detail sd INNER JOIN m5_si si ON sd.sumber = 'SI' AND sd.idtransaksi = si.siid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 UNION ALL SELECT sd.idsie AS sieid, sr.srcustomer AS customer_id FROM m5_sie_detail sd INNER JOIN m5_sr sr ON sd.sumber = 'SR' AND sd.idtransaksi = sr.srid ) x GROUP BY x.customer_id ) sie_agg ON sie_agg.customer_id = c.kid WHERE c.kaktif = 1 AND (COALESCE(si_agg.total_sales_invoice, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(sr_agg.total_sales_return, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(sie_agg.total_tukar_faktur, 0) > 0) ORDER BY total_sales_return DESC, total_tukar_faktur DESC, total_nilai_return DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Mutasi Poin Bulanan Transaksi Penjualan
queries.purpose: Menampilkan mutasi poin masuk, poin keluar, dan estimasi saldo akhir bulanan dari transaksi invoice penjualan.
queries.query: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(si.sitgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan, SUM(COALESCE(si.sipoinsebelumnya, 0)) AS total_saldo_awal_poin, SUM(COALESCE(si.sipoindidapat, 0)) AS total_poin_masuk, SUM(COALESCE(si.sibayarjmlpoin, 0)) AS total_poin_keluar, SUM(COALESCE(si.sipoinsebelumnya, 0) + COALESCE(si.sipoindidapat, 0) - COALESCE(si.sibayarjmlpoin, 0)) AS estimasi_saldo_akhir_poin, COUNT(si.siid) AS jumlah_invoice FROM m5_si si WHERE si.siisclose = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(si.sitgl, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY bulan ASC

queries.name: Penyesuaian Poin Manual per Bulan dan Customer
queries.purpose: Menampilkan mutasi penyesuaian poin manual per bulan per customer dari dokumen SPA.
queries.query: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(spa.spatgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan, c.kkode AS kode_customer, c.knama AS nama_customer, SUM(COALESCE(spad.poinlama, 0)) AS total_poin_lama, SUM(COALESCE(spad.poinmasuk, 0)) AS total_poin_masuk_manual, SUM(COALESCE(spad.poinkeluar, 0)) AS total_poin_keluar_manual, SUM(COALESCE(spad.poinbaru, 0)) AS total_poin_baru, COUNT(spad.idspadetail) AS jumlah_penyesuaian FROM m5_spa_detail spad INNER JOIN m5_spa spa ON spad.idspa = spa.spaid INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON spad.kontak = c.kid WHERE c.kaktif = 1 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(spa.spatgl, '%Y-%m'), c.kkode, c.knama ORDER BY bulan ASC, nama_customer ASC

queries.name: Ringkasan Bulanan Poin dan Penyesuaian Manual
queries.purpose: Menggabungkan mutasi poin transaksi penjualan dan penyesuaian manual per bulan dalam satu ringkasan dashboard.
queries.query: SELECT base.bulan AS bulan, COALESCE(si_agg.total_poin_masuk, 0) AS poin_masuk_transaksi, COALESCE(si_agg.total_poin_keluar, 0) AS poin_keluar_transaksi, COALESCE(spa_agg.total_poin_masuk_manual, 0) AS poin_masuk_manual, COALESCE(spa_agg.total_poin_keluar_manual, 0) AS poin_keluar_manual, COALESCE(si_agg.estimasi_saldo_akhir_poin, 0) + COALESCE(spa_agg.net_manual, 0) AS estimasi_saldo_akhir_gabungan FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(si.sitgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan FROM m5_si si WHERE si.siisclose = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(si.sitgl, '%Y-%m') UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(spa.spatgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan FROM m5_spa spa GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(spa.spatgl, '%Y-%m') ) base LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(si.sitgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan, SUM(COALESCE(si.sipoindidapat, 0)) AS total_poin_masuk, SUM(COALESCE(si.sibayarjmlpoin, 0)) AS total_poin_keluar, SUM(COALESCE(si.sipoinsebelumnya, 0) + COALESCE(si.sipoindidapat, 0) - COALESCE(si.sibayarjmlpoin, 0)) AS estimasi_saldo_akhir_poin FROM m5_si si WHERE si.siisclose = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(si.sitgl, '%Y-%m') ) si_agg ON base.bulan = si_agg.bulan LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(spa.spatgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan, SUM(COALESCE(spad.poinmasuk, 0)) AS total_poin_masuk_manual, SUM(COALESCE(spad.poinkeluar, 0)) AS total_poin_keluar_manual, SUM(COALESCE(spad.poinmasuk, 0) - COALESCE(spad.poinkeluar, 0)) AS net_manual FROM m5_spa_detail spad INNER JOIN m5_spa spa ON spad.idspa = spa.spaid INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON spad.kontak = c.kid WHERE c.kaktif = 1 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(spa.spatgl, '%Y-%m') ) spa_agg ON base.bulan = spa_agg.bulan ORDER BY base.bulan ASC

Saya tidak memakai join polymorphic IC/PV karena user meminta customer berisiko level dashboard dan schema tidak memberi definisi eksplisit yang aman untuk menghitung collection lambat dari IC/PV lintas seluruh sumber tanpa asumsi tambahan; sebagai gantinya collection lambat diproksikan dari aging overdue invoice dan rata-rata hari overdue invoice yang belum lunas, yang tetap sesuai konteks risiko penagihan. Query 1 membuat ranking customer berisiko dengan gabungan metrik: outstanding, invoice overdue, aging maksimum/rata-rata, nilai retur, dan jumlah SO yang belum selesai. Query 2 memecah komponen risiko per customer agar dashboard bisa menunjukkan faktor dominan. Query 3 memberi tren bulanan customer berisiko berdasarkan invoice overdue dan retur. Semua query tetap read-only dan kompatibel MySQL/MariaDB.

queries.name: Customer Risk Ranking
queries.purpose: Merangking customer berisiko berdasarkan kombinasi outstanding, aging overdue, retur, dan fulfillment macet.
queries.query: SELECT c.kid AS customer_id, c.kkode AS customer_code, c.knama AS customer_name, COALESCE(si_metrics.total_outstanding, 0) AS total_outstanding, COALESCE(si_metrics.overdue_invoice_count, 0) AS overdue_invoice_count, COALESCE(si_metrics.max_overdue_days, 0) AS max_overdue_days, COALESCE(si_metrics.avg_overdue_days, 0) AS avg_overdue_days, COALESCE(sr_metrics.total_return_value, 0) AS total_return_value, COALESCE(sr_metrics.return_doc_count, 0) AS return_doc_count, COALESCE(so_metrics.open_so_count, 0) AS open_so_count, COALESCE(so_metrics.stuck_fulfillment_count, 0) AS stuck_fulfillment_count, (COALESCE(si_metrics.total_outstanding, 0) + (COALESCE(si_metrics.overdue_invoice_count, 0) * 1000000) + (COALESCE(si_metrics.max_overdue_days, 0) * 10000) + COALESCE(sr_metrics.total_return_value, 0) + (COALESCE(so_metrics.stuck_fulfillment_count, 0) * 500000)) AS risk_score_proxy FROM m1_contact c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT si.sicustomer, SUM(GREATEST(si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0), 0)) AS total_outstanding, SUM(CASE WHEN GREATEST(si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0), 0) > 0 AND si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() > si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_invoice_count, MAX(CASE WHEN GREATEST(si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0), 0) > 0 AND si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() > si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) ELSE 0 END) AS max_overdue_days, AVG(CASE WHEN GREATEST(si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0), 0) > 0 AND si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() > si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) END) AS avg_overdue_days FROM m5_si si WHERE si.siisclose = 0 GROUP BY si.sicustomer ) si_metrics ON c.kid = si_metrics.sicustomer LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sr.srcustomer, SUM(COALESCE(sr.srtotaltransaksi, 0)) AS total_return_value, COUNT(sr.srid) AS return_doc_count FROM m5_sr sr GROUP BY sr.srcustomer ) sr_metrics ON c.kid = sr_metrics.srcustomer LEFT JOIN ( SELECT so.socustomer, COUNT(so.soid) AS open_so_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(so.sostatusrealisasi, '') <> 'LUNAS' AND COALESCE(so.sostatusrealisasi, '') <> 'SELESAI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stuck_fulfillment_count FROM m5_so so WHERE so.soisclose = 0 GROUP BY so.socustomer ) so_metrics ON c.kid = so_metrics.socustomer WHERE c.kaktif = 1 AND ( COALESCE(si_metrics.total_outstanding, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(sr_metrics.total_return_value, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(so_metrics.stuck_fulfillment_count, 0) > 0 ) ORDER BY risk_score_proxy DESC, total_outstanding DESC, max_overdue_days DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Risk Components Distribution
queries.purpose: Menampilkan distribusi komponen risiko per customer agar terlihat faktor dominan risiko.
queries.query: SELECT risk_base.customer_name, 'Outstanding' AS risk_component, risk_base.total_outstanding AS risk_value FROM ( SELECT c.knama AS customer_name, COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0), 0)), 0) AS total_outstanding, 0 AS aging_value, 0 AS return_value, 0 AS stuck_value FROM m1_contact c LEFT JOIN m5_si si ON si.sicustomer = c.kid AND si.siisclose = 0 WHERE c.kaktif = 1 GROUP BY c.kid, c.knama ) risk_base WHERE risk_base.total_outstanding > 0 UNION ALL SELECT risk_base.customer_name, 'Aging Overdue Days' AS risk_component, risk_base.aging_value AS risk_value FROM ( SELECT c.knama AS customer_name, 0 AS total_outstanding, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN GREATEST(si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0), 0) > 0 AND si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() > si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS aging_value, 0 AS return_value, 0 AS stuck_value FROM m1_contact c LEFT JOIN m5_si si ON si.sicustomer = c.kid AND si.siisclose = 0 WHERE c.kaktif = 1 GROUP BY c.kid, c.knama ) risk_base WHERE risk_base.aging_value > 0 UNION ALL SELECT risk_base.customer_name, 'Return Value' AS risk_component, risk_base.return_value AS risk_value FROM ( SELECT c.knama AS customer_name, 0 AS total_outstanding, 0 AS aging_value, COALESCE(SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi), 0) AS return_value, 0 AS stuck_value FROM m1_contact c LEFT JOIN m5_sr sr ON sr.srcustomer = c.kid WHERE c.kaktif = 1 GROUP BY c.kid, c.knama ) risk_base WHERE risk_base.return_value > 0 UNION ALL SELECT risk_base.customer_name, 'Stuck Fulfillment SO' AS risk_component, risk_base.stuck_value AS risk_value FROM ( SELECT c.knama AS customer_name, 0 AS total_outstanding, 0 AS aging_value, 0 AS return_value, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(so.sostatusrealisasi, '') <> 'LUNAS' AND COALESCE(so.sostatusrealisasi, '') <> 'SELESAI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS stuck_value FROM m1_contact c LEFT JOIN m5_so so ON so.socustomer = c.kid AND so.soisclose = 0 WHERE c.kaktif = 1 GROUP BY c.kid, c.knama ) risk_base WHERE risk_base.stuck_value > 0 ORDER BY risk_value DESC, customer_name ASC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Risk Trend Monthly
queries.purpose: Menampilkan tren bulanan risiko customer berdasarkan invoice overdue dan retur penjualan.
queries.query: SELECT month_label, SUM(overdue_outstanding) AS overdue_outstanding, SUM(return_value) AS return_value, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS risky_customer_count FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(si.sitgl, '%Y-%m') AS month_label, si.sicustomer AS customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN GREATEST(si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0), 0) > 0 AND si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() > si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN GREATEST(si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0), 0) ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_outstanding, 0 AS return_value FROM m5_si si WHERE si.siisclose = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(si.sitgl, '%Y-%m'), si.sicustomer UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sr.srtgl, '%Y-%m') AS month_label, sr.srcustomer AS customer_id, 0 AS overdue_outstanding, SUM(COALESCE(sr.srtotaltransaksi, 0)) AS return_value FROM m5_sr sr GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(sr.srtgl, '%Y-%m'), sr.srcustomer ) x GROUP BY month_label ORDER BY month_label ASC
